rows.currentBehaviorEvidence: packages/adapters/test/app/stage-driver.test.mjs:2012 — keeps an expired Relay quote retryable before any request or broadcast. Asserts terminalState=null, zero requests/broadcasts, no persisted operational-stage attempt, and the cycle remains the active/retryable cycle after reopen, at the low-level createStageDriver primitive. This is the nonterminal, no-attempt shape the proposed row already needs; it does not prove the frozen canonical HELD_UNAVAILABLE contract is exercised end-to-end (no source path was found calling holdCycle for this error), nor does it prove the proposed refresh-after-readmission classification, scheduler wiring, or alert reason, which remain unimplemented.
rows.requiredBeforePromotion: Implement a policy/admission-boundary quote-refresh that proves no signed or broadcast attempt exists before atomically admitting one replacement quote for the same claimed principal, wire the durable classification/reason and scheduler transition, add a focused test that exercises the refresh end-to-end, and cite it in place of this row.

rows.note: Proposed split #2 of 2 — new failureClass, does not exist in the canonical matrix today. Lease loss discovered after a provider-mutation capability boundary was reached (the provider mutation may already have been sent) is not the same evidence class as pre-boundary loss and must not share its retry tuple. Lease loss discovered after a signing capability boundary was reached is a third, distinct case governed by the existing chain-attempt PREPARED/SIGNED/BROADCAST/REFUSED states, not by this row.
rows.currentBehaviorEvidence: No lease-specific post-capability test exists at this head. The nearest existing analog for the general SENT_UNKNOWN/reconcile pattern used elsewhere in this repository is packages/adapters/test/app/stage-driver.test.mjs:2673 — keeps a Collector committed-then-503 attempt SENT_UNKNOWN after reopen until reconciliation (a different failure class; cited only to show the pattern this row would reuse, not as evidence this case is already covered).
rows.requiredBeforePromotion: Classify lease loss discovered after a provider-mutation capability boundary as SENT_UNKNOWN, forbid any automatic retry or provider mutation until canonical reconciliation resolves the prior attempt, add a lease-specific focused test, and cite it in place of this row.

rows.note: Proposed split #2 of 2 — new failureClass, does not exist in the canonical matrix today. Scoped ONLY to the verified owned Keychain sign-only broker per decisions/ADR-0025-bounded-transient-recovery-classification.md's 'Sign-only bounded retry' section (source-cited there against packages/adapters/src/signing/keychain-signer.mjs, packages/adapters/bin/hookemon-keychain-signer.mjs, and related files); an opaque or external-module signer's timeout keeps the current no-automatic-retry, terminal whole-cycle class and is NOT covered by this row. This is not the same mechanism as the effect-ambiguous rows above: it is a proven-pre-effect-transient retry made safe by durably binding identical unsigned bytes/identity/digests before invocation and deduplicating any resulting signature, not by proving no signature was returned.
rows.currentBehaviorEvidence: No timeout-specific test exists at this head. packages/adapters/bin/hookemon-keychain-signer.mjs:203-215 proves the checked-in broker refuses a broadcast operation and its sign operation therefore cannot itself submit a transaction; packages/adapters/test/app/stage-driver.test.mjs:1950 exercises only a synchronous denial, not a timeout, and the current build does not distinguish the two. No durable pre-invocation binding of unsigned bytes/identity/digest/validity-context exists yet (Collector purchase keeps generated unsigned bytes only in process memory), so the proposed retry cannot be safely enabled until that durable binding is implemented and a focused test proves identical-byte, idempotent-retry-with-dedup behavior for this exact broker.
rows.requiredBeforePromotion: Durably persist the exact unsigned wire bytes, signer role/account identity, request digest, policy/authorization digest, and validity context before invoking the Keychain broker's sign-only operation; on timeout, retry only against those exact values without regenerating the provider transaction, blockhash, nonce, memo, or policy; rely on the existing signed-bytes recovery record to deduplicate a signature from either attempt; add a focused test proving this exact contract for the Keychain broker specifically (not a generic signer); and cite it in place of this row. Do not apply this row's outcome to any opaque or external-module signer.
